integrity: The analytic proof is supplied in full, bundled finite computations are illustrative rather than a proof of infinite statements, and no independent external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic infinite-equilibrium obstruction and finite absorbing-boundary Perron limit for the symmetric discrete Laplace kernel and bounded directional mortality; no trajectory drift rate, stochastic claim, or renormalized-cutoff claim. The 1996 broad stationary-distribution paper was compared only by abstract; overlap with general spectral theory cannot be wholly excluded.
title: Directional mutation–selection has escaping finite equilibria but no infinite equilibrium
